title: Romancecar to Hakone · Yumoto soba · Open-Air Museum · Gora craft beer · geisha drinking games · Yumoto highballs

stops.name: Ninja House
stops.plan: Check out (deadline 10:00) with overnight bags only; the suitcases went to Osaka by TA-Q-BIN on Friday.
stops.transport: Walk to Ochiai-minami-nagasaki, Toei Oedo line → Nakano-sakaue, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi line → Shinjuku, then to the Odakyu Romancecar platforms, about 43 min

stops.name: Romancecar Shinjuku → Hakone-Yumoto
stops.plan: 8 reserved seats together on the ~11:00 Hakone Romancecar; the 3-day Hakone Freepass on EMot covers the fare. Grab ekiben and cans on the Odakyu concourse.

stops.name: Hatsuhana Soba
stops.plan: Yam-tororo soba, Yumoto's classic; take a waitlist ticket, the Shinkan building seats 8.
stops.transport: Walk back to Hakone-Yumoto Sta. (coin lockers for the bags), Hakone Tozan Railway to Chokoku-no-Mori, about 45 min (Freepass)

stops.name: Hakone Open-Air Museum
stops.plan: Sculpture park, the stained-glass Symphonic Sculpture tower and Picasso pavilion; it goes quiet after 15:30, end at the free footbath.
stops.transport: Walk up to Gora Brewery, 16 min

stops.name: Gora Brewery & Grill
stops.plan: Hakone's own brewpub (book a table for 8): a flight of house beers and a few grill plates to share as it gets dark.
stops.transport: Walk to Gora Sta., Hakone Tozan Railway Gora → Hakone-Yumoto (the 18:05), about 55 min door to door (Freepass); collect the bags from the lockers

stops.name: Izakaya Hakoneji
stops.plan: Booked table for 8: izakaya dinner and the first rounds before the geisha show.

stops.name: Furatto Geisha night, Hakone Yumoto Kenban
stops.plan: 3rd-Saturday 20:00 show (doors 19:30, walk over at 19:50 to sit together): three geisha dance, then ozashiki drinking games and photos.
stops.transport: Walk to Flying Chicken, 12 min (or phone for their free pick-up)

stops.name: Flying Chicken (Tori to Highball)
stops.plan: Yakitori and highballs at Yumoto's one late spot, booked for 8; grab breakfast and cans at a station konbini on the way out.
stops.transport: Taxi to the villa (2 cars, pre-booked; last trains and buses up the mountain are gone), 28 min

stops.name: Hot Spring Hakone Villa
stops.plan: Late self check-in (confirm the door code with the host), then a midnight soak in the villa's own hot spring.
